title: Minotaur
tagline: Minotaur follows the mythological Greece story of fury, revenge, and betrayal among the Greek gods. The labyrinth, brimming with mysteries and traps, becomes the stage for a gripping tale of heroism and destiny, where mortals and gods collide in a timeless struggle
description:
Introduction:
Welcome to Minotaur, an immersive and thrilling game that takes players on a journey through the mythological world of ancient Greece. Set in a labyrinth filled with mysteries, traps, and ancient gods, Minotaur offers a unique blend of algorithmically generated content and AI-generated NPC interactions, making every gameplay experience a captivating and unpredictable adventure.

Plot and Setting:
Minotaur revolves around the timeless struggle of fury, revenge, and betrayal among the Greek gods. The game's central theme is heroism and destiny, as mortals and gods clash in a grand battle that shapes the fate of the world. Players assume the role of a brave hero who finds themselves trapped in the legendary labyrinth, a complex and ever-changing maze that poses constant challenges and dangers.

Gameplay Mechanics:

Algorithmic Labyrinth Generation: One of Minotaur's key features is the algorithmic generator that creates the labyrinth each time a new game begins. This ensures that no two playthroughs are the same, adding an element of surprise and replayability. The labyrinth is brimming with secrets, hidden passages, and deadly traps, making exploration a crucial aspect of the game.

Traps and Challenges: As players navigate the labyrinth, they will encounter various traps designed to test their wit and reflexes. These traps include moving platforms, falling ceilings, spike pits, and other deadly obstacles that stand between the hero and their escape.

Player and Minotaur Positioning: The hero must avoid the menacing Minotaur, a half-man, half-bull creature that roams the labyrinth in search of its next prey. Players must use their cunning to outmaneuver the Minotaur and survive its relentless pursuit.

Coins and Win Gem: Scattered throughout the labyrinth are valuable coins that players can collect to gain rewards and increase their score. However, the ultimate goal is to locate the elusive Win Gem, a powerful artifact with the ability to free the hero from the labyrinth and complete their quest.

Random NPC Speech Generated by AI: As players progress through the game, they will encounter various non-playable characters (NPCs) who offer guidance, quests, or cryptic hints. These NPCs' speech is generated using AI, allowing for dynamic and engaging interactions that adapt to each player's unique journey.

Blockchain Integration:
Minotaur incorporates blockchain technology to enhance the gaming experience. It leverages two types of Ethereum tokens:

dNFT ERC721: The game employs the ERC721 standard to create unique digital assets showcasing the last winner's achievements.

MNT Tokens ERC20: The game's native currency, MNT tokens, are ERC20-compliant tokens that players can earn through gameplay achievements, completing quests, or winning contests. MNT tokens can be used to purchase in-game items, access exclusive content, or participate in special events, fostering a vibrant in-game economy.

Craziness and Fun:
Minotaur isn't just about its deep mythology and immersive gameplay; it also embraces the spirit of craziness and fun. Players will encounter whimsical characters, humorous dialogues, and unexpected events that keep them entertained throughout their adventure.

Conclusion:
Minotaur is an ambitious and innovative game that transports players to the mythological world of ancient Greece. With its algorithmically generated labyrinth, unpredictable AI-generated NPC interactions, and blockchain integration, it offers a truly unique and captivating gaming experience. Prepare to embark on an epic journey filled with danger, intrigue, and triumph as you challenge fate, navigate the labyrinth, and confront the Minotaur in this thrilling tale of fury and betrayal. Are you ready to become the hero of this ancient saga?
how_its_made:
1. Technology Stack:
To build "Minotaur," the game developers would likely use a combination of programming languages, frameworks, and tools suitable for game development. A possible technology stack could include:

Game Engine: Unity or Unreal Engine, both widely used and powerful game engines that offer a range of tools and features for developing 2D and 3D games.

Programming Language: C# is commonly used for game development in Unity, while Unreal Engine supports C++ and Blueprints (visual scripting).

Blockchain Integration: For implementing blockchain features such as dNFTs and ERC20 tokens, the developers might use Ethereum smart contracts written in Solidity.

AI-Generated NPC Speech: For generating dynamic NPC speech, the developers could integrate API call to AI to update the random speach.

2. Algorithmic Labyrinth Generation:
The algorithmic labyrinth generation can be achieved through procedural level generation techniques. The developers would implement algorithms to create random layouts, maze structures, and trap placements in the labyrinth. The algorithms would ensure that each new game generates a unique and challenging maze.

3. Blockchain Integration:
To incorporate dNFTs and ERC20 tokens, the developers would create and deploy smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. The dNFT ERC721 contract would manage unique digital assets, and the MNT Tokens ERC20 contract would handle the game's native currency.

4. Sponsor Technologies:

- XMTP: Upon a player's victory in the game, a notification will be broadcasted to all active players, signaling the completion of the current round and the need to commence a new one. However, to ensure a fair and balanced gameplay experience, there will be a brief cooldown period of 1 minute before the next round can be initiated. During this time, players will need to wait patiently before starting another exciting round of the game.
The APP checks active wallets using XMTP and playing and send a message to all of them.
